workflow_states_canonical.detail: Work orders, orders, evidence review V2, risk signals, contractor/tenant onboarding use explicit enums/constants. Projection layers (Today, Command Centre) derive from upstream truth.
gaps: No single unified workflow engine; domain-specific state machines

transitions_auditable.detail: ~292 AuditAction types; create_audit_log() on pricing, schedule, assignment, evidence mutations.
gaps: Some notification paths audit via message_logs only

events_emitted_consistently.detail: Domain collections (subscription_operational_events, enablement, pilot) + in-app WO notifications.
gaps: No generic event bus; cross-domain automation requires bespoke wiring

notifications_idempotent.detail: NotificationOrchestrator idempotency_key unique index, throttle, plan gate, retry worker.
gaps: Contractor in-app notification centre limited; email registry has unimplemented triggers

background_jobs_exist.detail: APScheduler + 48 JOB_RUNNERS; Mongo queues for recalc, regen, extraction.
gaps: No Celery/broker; scheduler/API coupling; registry drift on 2 jobs

queues_handle_volume.detail: Compliance recalc + risk regen workers with reclaim/dead-letter patterns.
gaps: No load test evidence for notification escalation at scale

tenant_client_scoping_safe.detail: Route guards, client_id/contractor_id checks on WO/issue mutations.
gaps: Automation must inherit same guards; no cross-tenant batch without admin scope

stale_cache_misleads.detail: Command Centre trust_surface_observability flags STALE_DATA_POSSIBLE; scoring_semantics_v1 stale policy.
gaps: Frontend list caches; dashboard summary can lag until refresh

ai_outputs_constrained.detail: trust_language_governance.py; extraction confidence thresholds; match reason codes.
gaps: No central confidence scoring service for all AI-assisted outputs

evidence_semantics_clear.detail: EvidenceReviewState V2 + requirement_truth evidence states + CER verification.

duplicate_prevention_exists.detail: Issue/WO idempotency services, operational_root_key, notification idempotency.
gaps: Risk-signal→WO HTTP idempotency test gap noted in prior audits

existing_foundations: Idempotency keys on issues, WOs, notifications

missing_or_weak_foundations.reason: Cross-module automation (quote stall → Today bump → notify) requires bespoke wiring today
Escalation ladders need per-WO/per-entity timer state (e.g. T+24h quote pending)
Document classification and remediation drafts need shared confidence→action mapping
Escalation must respect per-role/per-event opt-out to avoid spam
Detect false-positive nudges (already resolved), stale automation triggers
Exists for admin actions; extend for automation suppression overrides
2 jobs missing from registry → SLA watchdog blind spot

architecture_verdict: Platform can support Phase 1 automation (notify, prioritise, recommend) safely using existing orchestrator + scheduler. Phase 2+ requires workflow timers and reconciliation before semi-autonomous operations.
